value: Property Rent Law, Law No. 27 of 2014 (in force six months after publication in the Official Gazette).
source_publisher: Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission (Kingdom of Bahrain)
note: English text of Law No. 27 of 2014 on the site of the official legislation commission; the document carries a note that the official version is the Arabic one in the Official Gazette.

value: Lease agreements within the scope of the Law must be in writing and registered, with any later alterations, within one month of conclusion; the fact of leasing may be proven by all methods of evidence (Art. 3). Registration fee is set by ministerial order and is borne by the lessor (Art. 7).
source_publisher: Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission (Kingdom of Bahrain)
note: English text of Law No. 27 of 2014 on the site of the official legislation commission; the document carries a note that the official version is the Arabic one in the Official Gazette.

value: A lease concluded without an agreed period, or whose period cannot be proven, is treated as concluded for the rent-payment period (Art. 4(A)).
source_publisher: Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission (Kingdom of Bahrain)
note: English text of Law No. 27 of 2014 on the site of the official legislation commission; the document carries a note that the official version is the Arabic one in the Official Gazette.

value: The lessor may not increase rent until two years from the lease start or the last increase; the increase is 5% for residential use and 7% for commercial, industrial and other uses, at most five times during the lease, unless otherwise agreed in writing (Art. 27(a)).
source_publisher: Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission (Kingdom of Bahrain)
note: English text of Law No. 27 of 2014 on the site of the official legislation commission; the document carries a note that the official version is the Arabic one in the Official Gazette.

value: The lessor must notify the tenant of the intended increase by registered letter at least three months before the end of the second year, unless otherwise agreed (Art. 27(c)).
source_publisher: Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission (Kingdom of Bahrain)
note: English text of Law No. 27 of 2014 on the site of the official legislation commission; the document carries a note that the official version is the Arabic one in the Official Gazette.

value: A tenant who wishes to vacate must notify the lessor by registered letter at least three months before the expiry date (Art. 34(b)).
source_publisher: Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission (Kingdom of Bahrain)
note: English text of Law No. 27 of 2014 on the site of the official legislation commission; the document carries a note that the official version is the Arabic one in the Official Gazette.

value: If the term expires and the tenant stays with the lessor's knowledge and without objection, the lease is treated as extended for a similar period on the same conditions (Art. 34(a)).
source_publisher: Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission (Kingdom of Bahrain)
note: English text of Law No. 27 of 2014 on the site of the official legislation commission; the document carries a note that the official version is the Arabic one in the Official Gazette.

value: A lease does not end on the death of the lessor or tenant; the tenant's heirs may request termination within one year of the death (Art. 36(a)).
source_publisher: Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission (Kingdom of Bahrain)
